batches.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Transparent game sprite sheet of the approved Fox, using the supplied image as the exact character reference. Preserve his small orange fox identity: bright orange fur, cream muzzle and chest, huge orange bushy tail with cream tip, tall black-tipped ears with pink inner ears, large brown eyes, black nose and little red tongue. He remains a four-legged fox with exactly four animal paws, no clothing, no human hands or fingers, no extra limbs. For two-paw gripping actions he may briefly rear upright on his hind paws and use his two front paws as fox paws. Exactly EIGHT full-body poses, four columns and two rows, read left to right then next row. Consistent head size and character proportions, bold clean navy outlines and soft cel shading matching the reference, three-quarter view facing RIGHT, generous transparent gutters; all ears, tail, paws fully inside every cell. ROW 1: 1 tug-of-war ready: hind paws planted, torso leaning BACK left, both front paws held together reaching forward-right at waist height to grip an invisible rope, cheerful determined face; 2 tug heave: lean farther back, knees bent, same forward empty two-paw grip, joyful exertion; 3 fishing reel ready: reared on hind paws, leaning back slightly, near front paw reaching forward-right at chest height as if gripping an invisible rod, other front paw beside it ready to crank, focused cheerful gaze right; 4 fishing reel crank: same planted hind paws and forward grip, other front paw moved inward/down to crank an invisible reel, bright grin. ROW 2: 5 overhead swing windup: reared with hind legs braced, both front paws together above the right shoulder, empty grip, gleeful face; 6 swing followthrough: both front paws moved forward-right and upward above the face, finishing a gentle overhead strike, happy grin; 7 putting ready: side-on facing right, fox crouched on all four paws, forepaws together low and forward-right as if holding an invisible putter, looking down-right; 8 putting followthrough: same low four-paw stance, one forepaw extended slightly forward-right after a gentle putt, looking up-right hopefully. No rope, rod, fishing line, bat, putter, balls, scenery, ground, shadows, text, labels, motion effects. True transparent background.
